# AGI

> AGI is an AI application suite across six surfaces — Web, Desktop, Mobile, CLI, Chrome extension, and VS Code extension — that lets you run AI three ways: Local (on your device), BYOK (your own provider keys, no markup), or AGI managed cloud (public alpha, open by default). You see the route before anything leaves your machine.

AGI (formal platform name: AGI Workforce) is published by AGI Automation LLC, Austin, Texas. Its differentiation is model neutrality and explicit trust boundaries, not a single frontier lab.

## Trust modes (honest availability)

- Local: on-device chat and tools through Ollama or LM Studio on Desktop and CLI, plus an on-device Local Mode on Mobile. No account, works offline. Free.
- BYOK (Bring Your Own Key): your own provider API keys on Desktop and CLI. Keys are encrypted at rest on your machine, traffic goes directly to the provider, usage is billed by the provider with no AGI markup, and a provider label is visible on every route. Free.
- Managed cloud: AGI-hosted provider access. In public alpha and open by default — sign in and start, no waitlist. Usage is metered; higher-capacity paid plans (Basic, Pro, Max) are the individual on-ramp. Team and Enterprise (org seats, SSO, admin controls) are the only early-access / waitlisted tiers.

Local, BYOK, and Managed Cloud are separate trust boundaries. A Local chat is never silently routed to BYOK or managed cloud; moving to BYOK is an explicit, reviewed continuation with consent and a visible provider label.

## Providers

10+ providers: nine first-party cloud APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Qwen, Moonshot, Zhipu), two local runtimes (Ollama and LM Studio), and any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. You can switch providers mid-conversation and keep your history.

## Workspace capabilities

Chat, artifacts (sandboxed previews with versions and downloads), projects, tools and connectors (MCP servers and OAuth apps with per-call permission review), memory (plain-language facts you control), deep research with citations, agents (delegated, sandboxed, permissioned sessions), plugins, and skills.

## Status

All six surfaces are progressing toward a public launch targeted for July 12, 2026. Managed cloud is live in public alpha today. Claims of availability, pricing, and compliance are stated honestly with dates; where something is planned rather than shipped, the pages say so.
